statements.status_notes: msgpack 1.1.2 is the copy vendored in the pip 26.0.1 wheel that virtualenv 21.15.5 bundles only for Python 3.9. This image runs Python 3.13, and virtualenv selects pip 26.3 for that interpreter. pip 26.3 vendors msgpack 1.2.4, and the application copy is pinned to 1.2.4. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-114613

msgpack 1.1.2 is the copy vendored in the pip 26.0.1 wheel that virtualenv 21.15.5 bundles only for Python 3.9. This image runs Python 3.13, and virtualenv selects pip 26.3 for that interpreter. pip 26.3 vendors msgpack 1.2.4, and the application copy is pinned to 1.2.4. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-114613

Scanners report pkg:pypi/msgpack@1.1.2 from the copy pip vendors under pip/_vendor/msgpack (listed in pip/_vendor/vendor.txt). This image installs no standalone msgpack distribution, and pip's vendored copy is pure Python only (__init__.py, exceptions.py, ext.py, fallback.py), with no msgpack._cmsgpack C extension. CVE-2026-114613 (GHSA-j586-36cw-2gc2) covers a map-value leak when strict_map_key rejects a key and a stale parser-stack reference in the streaming Unpacker, both in the C sources (msgpack/unpack.h, msgpack/unpack_template.h) that build msgpack._cmsgpack; the pure-Python fallback checks the key before decoding the value and does not contain that code.

Scanners report pkg:pypi/msgpack@1.1.2 from pip's vendored copy under pip/_vendor/msgpack (vendor.txt and bom.cdx.json). DHI python images ship pip's pure-Python fallback only (__init__.py, exceptions.py, ext.py, fallback.py); there is no msgpack._cmsgpack C extension in that tree. CVE-2026-114613 is an unbounded memory leak in the C extension when strict_map_key rejects a map key; upstream and Debian document that the pure-Python fallback does not exhibit this leak.

msgpack 1.1.2 appears in the SBOM as a cataloger artifact sourced from jupyter_client's test-extra dependency declaration in its METADATA file. The package is not installed in the /opt/singleuser/.venv Python environment and cannot be imported at runtime. The vulnerable code is not present in the running container.

Alias of CVE-2026-57585. pip vendors msgpack 1.1.2 without the vulnerable _cmsgpack C extension; only the pure-Python fallback is present under pip/_vendor/msgpack.

pip's vendored msgpack is the pure-Python fallback only (fallback.py, ext.py, exceptions.py). CVE-2026-57585 is a use-after-free in the Cython _cmsgpack extension; pip does not ship that native module and always falls back to the pure-Python implementation.
